text: I realised that as I watched the play of his eager features, and heard him struggle for expression on his favourite hobby; all his pet phrases translated crudely into the most excruciating German. He was convincing, because he was himself. “Are there many like you in England?” asked von Brüning once. Of course—lots,” said Davies. “I wish there were more in Germany; they play at yachting over here—on shore half the time, drinking and loafing; paid crews, clean hands, white trousers; laid up in the middle of September.” “We haven’t seen many yachts about, said Davies, politely.
